thread:
Sam Chen: Heads up — customer wants signed order form + countersigned MSA before POC starts. They insist on EU entity signer, customer-managed HSM attestation, and net45 payment terms. Can legal/finance confirm we can accept a proxy signer for the EU company? :thinking:

Arun Patel: We can provision Dedicated/Private for the POC. If they want BYOK/HSM that’s only supported on Private deployments. What exact attestation wording do they want?

Priya Rao: Sam — drop the redline and orderform here so I can review MSA/DPA tweaks for KMS and SLA. Proxy signing needs a delegation/POA and a PO for billing to be valid.

Mei Wong: Also need billing entity name + VAT. If finance agrees to net45 we still require a PO before raising invoice. If they want consolidated invoices across regions we need legal approval for cross-entity billing.

Jordan Kim: Net45 okay with conditions — we'll need procurement PO and a credit review. If procurement is slow, ask if they can prepay for the POC (proforma). Also, what SLA level are they asking? Anything above standard needs RevOps approval.

Sam Chen: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood.example/VerticalCloud_Orderform_v2.pdf and VerticalCloud_MSA_redline.docx

Priya Rao: Quick skim. Their redline says: "Customer-managed HSM with attestation and key control". Our position: permit customer-managed HSM only for Private deployments and require attestation within 30 days of go-live; otherwise we enable Redwood-managed KMS. I'll draft counter language.

Emma (security): They flagged data residency, encryption-at-rest, key rotation cadence, and key escrow policy in the security questionnaire. Our standard responses are in the secure QA doc: https://redwood.internal/secure/kb-crypto.

Arun Patel: For signature flow they want two envelopes: billing contact signs orderform, exec signs MSA. Can DocuSign do chained envelopes? Proposed routing: ["billing_contact", "legal_counsel", "exec_signatory"]. Also they want EU proxy support.

Priya Rao: DocuSign chain is fine. For proxy signing we require evidence of delegation: notarized POA, board resolution, or an authorized signatory letter. Scanned delegation plus corporate registry entry should be acceptable for EU corporate signers.

Mei Wong: Who is the invoice recipient? That decides which VAT/PO we check against. Sam, confirm ASAP.

Sam Chen: Customer confirmed invoices to "VerticalCloud EU Ltd" (VAT EU-VC-9988). Procurement will raise PO but expect ~10 business days.

Jordan Kim: Finance can accept invoicing to that entity but will place credit on hold until PO is received. We can issue a proforma invoice to unblock provisioning if they prepay.

Priya Rao: Draft counter for HSM clause: "Customer-managed HSM allowed for Private deployments only. Customer must supply independent HSM attestation from an approved assessor within 30 days after go-live. If attestation is not provided, Redwood will revert to Redwood-managed KMS. BYOK/key export requires prior security exception approval." I'll insert this as a tracked change.

Sam Chen: Also they requested a 99.99% uptime SLA with financial credits. Thoughts?

Jordan Kim: 99.99% increases risk exposure. We can offer 99.95% for Dedicated with a capped credit schedule. 99.99% would require multi-region Dedicated + additional ops SLA and a fee. Need Ops/Product signoff.

Arun Patel: Ops side: 4 nines is doable but only with cross-region redundancy and active failover — adds cost and complexity. I'll estimate required capacity and cost delta.

Priya Rao: Proposed compromise: conditional 99.99% available as an add-on if customer commits to a 12-month reserved capacity and pays the SLA uplift. That limits exposure and aligns cost.

docu_sign_bot: Envelope created for MSA/orderform. Recipients: Priya Rao, Sam Chen, billing_contact. Envelope ID: env_9f8e7d.

Sam Chen: Customer needs countersign by EOD Friday. Legal — can we do that?

Priya Rao: Tight but possible if we finalize the KMS/SLA counters quickly. I’ll upload tracked changes tomorrow AM and route back to the envelope.

Mei Wong: After signatures, I'll kickoff provisioning. If they choose prepay, send billing contact to me and I’ll generate proforma.

Sam Chen: Next steps: Priya to post MSA counters tomorrow AM; Jordan to confirm proforma/credit policy; Arun to return ops cost for 99.99% multi-region; Sam to request delegation docs from customer. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
